title: Credit Card Form
content: Build secure credit card input form. Card number: format with spaces (4444 5555 6666 7777), max 19 characters. Card type detection: detect Visa/Mastercard/Amex from first digits, show icon. Expiry: MM/YY format, auto-add slash. CVV: 3-4 digits based on card type. Card preview: visual card representation. Validation: Luhn algorithm for card number. Security: never log card data.

variants.simple: Create credit card form with card number, expiry, and CVV fields.
variants.detailed: Build secure credit card input form. Card number: format with spaces (4444 5555 6666 7777), max 19 characters. Card type detection: detect Visa/Mastercard/Amex from first digits, show icon. Expiry: MM/YY format, auto-add slash. CVV: 3-4 digits based on card type. Card preview: visual card representation. Validation: Luhn algorithm for card number. Security: never log card data.
variants.advanced: Build secure credit card input form with validation and visual feedback. Card number field: format with spaces as user types (4444 5555 6666 7777), max 19 characters (16 digits + 3 spaces), inputMode="numeric" for mobile keyboard. Card type detection: detect from first digits (4=Visa, 51-55/2221-2720=Mastercard, 34/37=Amex, 6011/65=Discover, etc.), show appropriate brand icon next to input, update max length for Amex (15 digits). Expiry field: MM/YY format, auto-add slash after 2 digits, validate month 01-12, validate not in past (compare to current month/year). CVV field: 3 digits for most cards, 4 digits for Amex, type="password" or type="text" with dots, inputMode="numeric". Name field: cardholder name as on card, text-transform: uppercase for display. Single line option: all fields in one row for compact checkout layout. Card preview: visual card representation (200x125px rounded-xl with gradient background) showing entered values live - card number masked (•••• •••• •••• 1234), expiry, name, brand logo positioned realistically. Validation: Luhn algorithm for card number validity, all fields required, show inline errors (text-red-600 text-sm below each field). Error states: red border (border-red-500), error icon, error message. Security: NEVER log card data, don't store in state longer than needed, use appropriate autocomplete attributes (cc-number, cc-exp, cc-csc), add autocomplete="off" if not using browser autofill. PCI compliance note: in production, use hosted fields from payment processor (Stripe Elements, Braintree, Adyen) that collect card data in iframes, never touching your servers. Icons: card type icons (credit card brands), Lock icon for security indicator, "Secure payment" text. Keyboard: auto-advance focus between fields (number → expiry → CVV → name), numeric keyboard on mobile. Add "Save card for future purchases" checkbox option.
